animation_rules.camera_mechanism: SVG <g id="camera_g"> transform="translate(tx ty) scale(s)"; tx and ty computed per frame from projected geographic camera centre; viewBox remains 0 0 1920 1080
animation_rules.route_drawing_mechanism: strokeDasharray = pathLength; strokeDashoffset animated from pathLength to 0
animation_rules.travelling_pulse_mechanism: for each pulse, compute point at normalized path position t on SVG path each frame and place SVG circle/short dash there

projection.base_fit: fitExtent([[60,40],[1860,1040]], GeoJSON subset covering West Africa, North Africa and Western Mediterranean)

easing.spring_card: spring({frame: localFrame, fps: 30, config: {damping: 18, stiffness: 120, mass: 0.9}})

camera.mechanism: A single SVG group wraps all projected map geography, routes, source point and geo-anchored connector start. The card and nameplates marked screen-positioned are outside or counter-scaled as specified. For each keyframe, compute projected point of centre_lonlat, then set camera_g transform to translate(960 - projectedX * zoom, 540 - projectedY * zoom) scale(zoom). Interpolate centre_lonlat and zoom per frame; never animate SVG viewBox.

elements.technical: SVG group of pulse particles travelling along route_morocco_core. Each particle is a short dash plus hot core: draw a mini path segment tangent to the route, length 18/zoom, stroke palette.pulse_gold_hot width 3/zoom with round caps, plus centre circle r 3.5/zoom fill palette.pulse_gold and glow filter gold_pulse_blur stdDeviation 5. Use computed point and tangent from normalized path position.

elements.animation: Frames 42-183. Starvation factor s = interpolate(frame,[42,183],[0,1],linear). activeCount = floor(interpolate(s,[0,1],[10,5])). spacing = 1 / activeCount. speed = interpolate(s,[0,1],[0.0115,0.0065]) normalized path units per frame. For particle i in 0..9, visible only if i < activeCount. tRaw = (speed * (frame - 42) + i * spacing) % 1. t = tRaw. End fade = smoothstep(0.025,0.11,t) * (1 - smoothstep(0.89,0.985,t)). Spawn fade = interpolate(frame,[42,58],[0,1],easeOutCubic). opacity = endFade * spawnFade * interpolate(s,[0,1],[0.95,0.52]). Dash length = interpolate(s,[0,1],[20,12]) / zoom. Circle radius = interpolate(s,[0,1],[4.2,2.8]) / zoom. To show starving, inter-pulse gaps visibly widen because count drops from 10 to 5 while speed slows by 43%; no new particles are created after count cutoff, they fade out over 8 frames using opacity interpolation.

opening_to_peak.description: The map does not cut. The lively opening route treatment visibly begins starving before the insert arrives. The dimming veil rises, the connector draws from Nigeria source to the card, and the owned pipe cutaway card scales/fades in over the still-readable map.

steps.action: Pre-transition starvation: opening travelling impulses reduce from 10 to 5 per route, speed drops from about 0.011 normalized path units/frame to about 0.006, opacity drops from 0.95 to 0.52, dash length drops from 20px to 12px.
peak_insert_card_body and shadow enter: opacity 0 -> 1, scale 0.965 -> 1 using spring_card, y offset 16px -> 0.
peak_connector_line draws from Nigeria source to card bottom: strokeDashoffset connectorLen -> 0 using easeOutCubic.
owned pipe cutaway video layer opacity 0 -> 1 inside the card.
The single figure badge appears: '~70%' opacity 0 -> 1 and scale 0.92 -> 1. No other figures are introduced anywhere.

peak_to_verdict.description: The figure leaves first, then the card and connector withdraw. The veil clears only after the insert is gone. The underlying map is not restored to the opening state; it resolves into the permanently weakened verdict state.

steps.action: peak_percent_badge '~70%' opacity 1 -> 0 using easeInCubic; after frame 362 the figure is unmounted and never appears again.
peak_insert_card_body, shadow, title, pipe video and video border opacity 1 -> 0; card scale 1 -> 0.985 and y offset 0 -> -10px.
peak_connector_line opacity 1 -> 0; dash flow stops when opacity reaches 0.
dimming veil opacity 0.40 -> 0 using easeInOutCubic. During this clearance, route opacities and source radii interpolate into verdict values rather than returning to opening values.
Only two tiny residual particles per route remain, moving at about 0.002 normalized path units/frame and fading to zero. Sober direction ticks and dim route lines remain after particles vanish.
Verdict source pulse is contracted: one ring only, period 54 frames, radius 7px -> 19px, max opacity 0.22; core radius decreases to 4px and opacity to 0.56 by the end.
